summary: design/paper/specs/combobox.geometry.json is back in the tree. geometry.browser.test.tsx and the combobox-option-row case were committed without it, so type-check failed (TS2307) and the browser suite's Vite overlay cascaded into ~170 unrelated failures. The spec is the one extracted from Component --- Combobox on 2026-11-02 (it had ended up in a local stash with unrelated demo exports); its values were re-checked against the sheet's option row (padding 12, gap 8, radius-sm, 16px lane). check:design-spec now covers 13 specs.
